title: Slice comparison normalization arrow
statement: Let X be a scheme, q:R→S a commutative ring map, and d:A→Res_q A′ an arrow of etale derived sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-normalization-arrows]. For U in X_proet, define the arrow from the slice restriction of comparison(A) to Res_q of the slice restriction of comparison(A′) by applying comparison and slice restriction to d, then the canonical comparison/coefficient isomorphism and inverse slice/coefficient isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-derived-morphism-sheaf-comparison]. This is a concrete composite, not a chosen normalization witness.

proof.text: Compose the image of d under derived comparison and restriction to U with the two displayed canonical coefficient comparisons. Every arrow is explicitly constructed from the existing exact functors.
